description: Delta Elevation coefficients per 100m altitude difference
source: Berechnungen Mor-ohne Map.xlsx - extracted from Polynome Delta ELEV Höhe section
usage: To calculate elevation adjustment: deltaElev = coefficient * (targetAltitude - mortarAltitude) / 100
notes: Coefficients are derived from Marcel's calculations
Higher ring counts have lower coefficients due to flatter trajectories
These values apply to both US and RUS mortars
